title: feat(spec)!: FileValue.duration and CompatibilityMatrixEntry.estimatedMigrationTime carry their unit in the key name (#18669)
body:
Fixes #18669
Part of #18124

Clause-②: yes

Maintainer ruling **A** (comment 5717168926, decision batch #151 item 4, 「其他同意」 2026-09-17T15:42Z):

> rename `FileValue.duration` → `durationSeconds` and `CompatibilityMatrixEntry.estimatedMigrationTime` → `estimatedMigrationTimeHours`, each with an ADR-0087 conversion-layer entry; ⛔ no new closed type, ⛔ no narrowing of stored data

Options B (adopt a closed type), C (new closed types) and D (retire both keys) were not chosen and are not implemented here.

| def | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `data/FileValue` | `duration: 12` | `durationSeconds: 12` |
| `kernel/CompatibilityMatrixEntry` | `estimatedMigrationTime: 8` | `estimatedMigrationTimeHours: 8` |

Both stay `z.number().optional()`. `durationSeconds: 12.34` still parses — the closed `DurationSeconds`
(`z.number().int().nonnegative()`, #18122) and a bare `.int()` were both refused by the ruling, and the
fractional case is pinned as a test.

## 1. Premise re-measured on `origin/main` before any edit

Taken at tip `ef256e6a8f9bf5744e071631f4337ded9c3b3b76`, 2026-09-21T06:17Z. Every construct was found by
NAME, never by the card's 2026-09-17 line numbers.

| what the card asserts | answer |
|:--|:--|
| `FileValue.duration` is still `z.number().optional()`, no unit in the name, no `externalVocabulary` | **holds** — `field-value.zod.ts` line 499, bare, no `.describe()`, no `.meta()` |
| `CompatibilityMatrixEntry.estimatedMigrationTime` is still `z.number().optional()` with the JSDoc "Estimated migration time in hours" | **holds** — `plugin-versioning.zod.ts` line 191, JSDoc verbatim at line 189, no `.describe()` |
| `check-duration-unit-keys.ts` still names three admission channels and the phrase "carries it in its NAME or in its TYPE, never only in its `.describe()` prose" | **holds** — verbatim at line 6; the ADMISSION section declares TYPE, NAME and prose (describe + JSDoc as the second prose channel), with the retired name-shape list explicitly not an admission channel |
| the two precedents in `migrations/registry.ts` | **both present** — `system/MetricAggregationConfig:window.size` and `system/ServiceLevelObjective:period.duration`, read in full; their entry shape is copied rather than invented |

The premise holds in all four places, so the implementation was built on it.

## 2. Producer / consumer census, each zero with a lit control

Instrument: `git grep` with **no pathspec** (the measured pathspec trap in this checkout), at
`ef256e6a8f9bf5744e071631f4337ded9c3b3b76`, 2026-09-21T06:20Z.

**`estimatedMigrationTime` — 9 lines / 5 files**, printed rather than counted: 3 generated doc rows
(`content/docs/references/kernel/plugin-versioning.mdx`), 2 generated ratchet rows
(`authorable-surface.base.json`, `authorable-surface/kernel.json`), 3 test lines
(`plugin-versioning.test.ts` 169/176/424) and the schema declaration itself. **Zero runtime producers,
zero runtime consumers.** Lit control, same instrument: `CompatibilityMatrixEntry` returns 39 rows across
13 files, so the grep is not silently answering nothing.

**`FileValue.duration`** — the bare token `duration` is repo-wide noise (628 files), so the instrument is
co-occurrence with `mimeType`: 25 files, of which the source hits are
`packages/spec/src/data/field-value.test.ts:362` (a fixture), `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx:1164`
(hand-written prose), `docs/adr/0104-...md:459` (ADR prose), `packages/spec/src/shared/duration.zod.ts:60`
and `duration.test.ts:70` (the #18122 six-row census), and `.changeset/18122-closed-duration-types.md:20`.
**Zero runtime producers, zero runtime consumers.** Lit control: the same instrument returns
`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, `packages/client/src/index.ts` and three more for the pair, so it is
reading real files; those files' `duration` hits are a hook-scope comment, `durationMs` and Tailwind
`duration-200` classes, none of them a file value.

**Reachability, measured rather than assumed:** `FileValueSchema` appears ONLY in the `expanded` arm of
`valueSchemaFor` — the `stored` arm is `FileReferenceIdValueSchema`, an opaque id string — and
`git grep "'expanded'"` over `packages` excluding `packages/spec` returns **zero** call sites, with the
same grep inside `packages/spec` returning hits as the lit control. So no write path and no read path in
this repo ever parses a value against this shape.

**objectui at the pinned sha** `87af769e9a3ee28ace099fdd653d3ebd79fe82e2` (`.objectui-sha` on `origin/main`):
`readFileValue` / `readFileValues` (`packages/fields/src/widgets/file-value.ts`) read `id`, `name`, `url`,
`mimeType`, `size` and **never** `duration`. Every `duration` hit in that tree is a toast timeout, a
`durationMs` field or a Tailwind transition class. Lit control: `git grep FileValue` at that sha returns 19
rows, so the instrument reaches the tree.

## 3. What landed

- `packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts` — `durationSeconds: z.number().optional().describe('Media duration in seconds')`, plus a `retiredKey()` tombstone on `duration`
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-versioning.zod.ts` — `estimatedMigrationTimeHours: z.number().optional().describe('Estimated migration time in hours')`, plus a `retiredKey()` tombstone on `estimatedMigrationTime`
- two ADR-0087 D3 semantic entries: **`data-file-value-duration-unit-in-key`** and **`kernel-compatibility-matrix-estimated-migration-time-unit-in-key`**
- two `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` rows: `data/FileValue:duration` and `kernel/CompatibilityMatrixEntry:estimatedMigrationTime`
- prose sweep: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx`, the `shared/duration.zod.ts` six-row census and its test comment
- regenerated: `authorable-surface/data.json`, `authorable-surface/kernel.json`, `migrations/registry.ts`, `content/docs/references/{data/field-value,kernel/plugin-versioning}.mdx`

Both authorable-surface rows are **top-level**, so the ratchet moves in both files:
`data/FileValue:duration [RETIRED]` beside `data/FileValue:durationSeconds`, and the same shape on
`kernel/CompatibilityMatrixEntry`. `authorable-surface.base.json` is deliberately **not** re-anchored.

### Why the describe on the hours key is not cosmetic

Renaming `estimatedMigrationTime` alone would have produced a NEW gate failure, not a fix: the key name
would carry `Hours`, the JSDoc would name hours, and the `.describe()` would name nothing —
`check:duration-unit-keys` refuses exactly that as `unit-in-jsdoc-not-in-describe` (the agreement shape,
ruled an offence 2026-09-18, decision batch #158 item 5, letter A). The remedy the gate names is to state
the unit in the describe, which is what this does. `FileValue.durationSeconds` gains one for the same
reader.

### Why no D2 conversion for either key

`FileValueSchema` is the ADR-0104 D3 wave-2 **expanded read** form, derived at read time from a `sys_file`
id; the stored form is an opaque string. A plugin compatibility matrix is a published version manifest and
`stack.zod.ts` declares no collection of them. Neither is ever a stored `sys_metadata` row, so the
conversion chain has no seam that would see one — the same disposition
`ai-conversation-analytics-duration-unit-in-key` and the two metrics entries already took.

## 4. Verification

Head under test: **`ccec095`** (`ccec0959cdd66f0b6188d33473811a37c2b5216a`), after merging `origin/main`
at `61170fa38`. The merge of `migrations/registry.ts` was a clean text merge of two sorted-union
insertions; `check:migration-registry` reads the result as current (228 semantic, 203 retired-key, 181
retired-def), so nothing was hand-resolved.

**Reverse verification against the rebuilt `.d.ts`** — a throwaway probe in `packages/objectql/src`,
type-checked through `node_modules` so it resolves `@objectstack/spec` via its `exports` into `dist/`:

- red leg: `duration: 12` and `estimatedMigrationTime: 8` produce **exactly two** `TS2322 Type 'number' is not assignable to type 'undefined'` errors, one per old spelling, and nothing else
- green control leg: the same file with only `durationSeconds: 12.34` and `estimatedMigrationTimeHours: 8` exits **0**
- the probe was removed and the removal proved by observation: `git diff HEAD` empty and `git status --porcelain` empty, not by the delete command's exit code

**Package tests** (each a real reading, not a summary):

| package | files | tests |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `@objectstack/spec` (the changed package) | 509 passed (509) | 14887 passed, 1 todo (14888) |
| `@objectstack/objectql` | 303 passed (303) | 5050 passed |
| `@objectstack/lint` | 106 passed (106) | 4039 passed |
| `@objectstack/service-analytics` | 113 passed (113) | 2411 passed |
| `@objectstack/driver-sql` | 178 passed, 11 skipped (189) | 2627 passed, 168 skipped |
| `@objectstack/cli` | 271 passed, 2 failed (273) | 3535 passed, 30 skipped, **0 failed** |

The consumer set is the packages that import `valueSchemaFor` from `@objectstack/spec/data` — the only
route by which this contract reaches another package, since no package outside `packages/spec` imports
`FileValueSchema` or `CompatibilityMatrixEntrySchema` by name.

Two honest non-passes, neither a red gate:

- `@objectstack/cli` — the two failing FILES are `test/published-subpath-console.pin.test.ts` and
  `test/published-subpath-hook-body.pin.test.ts`, both of which refuse their own prerequisite in words:
  *"packages/cli is not built (./dist/index.js is absent) … Run: pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build"*.
  Zero individual tests failed. **PREREQUISITE NOT MET**, not a pass and not a failure.
- `@objectstack/runtime` — **NOT MEASURED**: its suite did not finish inside this container's foreground
  window and was cut at 560s. Declared to CI rather than reported as green.

**Gate reconciliation** — `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran RAN_RECORD`
with every command recorded as `command :: exit code`, exit codes captured before any pipe:

```
Run reconciliation — 109 derived, 108 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
```

The one NOT-MEASURED is `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`, exit **3**: its
positive-control fixture is pinned to commit `621a487607881c66b2899b7e3477115229a156b4`, unreachable in
this shallow checkout. It refuses its own prerequisite rather than reporting a verdict, and it grades the
checker, not this diff.

Sixteen ratchet-sensitive families were re-run at the final head `ccec095` after the merge — `check:type-check-coverage`,
`check:type-check-debt`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:duration-unit-keys`, `check:api-surface`,
`check:generated`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:query-options-erasure`,
`check:strictness-ledger`, `check:liveness`, `check:docs`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide`,
`check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check:nul-bytes` — all exit 0.

`check:duration-unit-keys` reads **205 unit-declaring numeric keys across 2549 source files, zero
offenders, no baseline**, and its `--list` census shows both new keys admitted and satisfied:

```
packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts:510        durationSeconds              [name: seconds] [prose: seconds]  "Media duration in seconds"
packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-versioning.zod.ts:198 estimatedMigrationTimeHours [name: hours]   [prose: hours]    "Estimated migration time in hours"
```

**Lint — a declared narrowing, with its three readings.** `pnpm lint` is `eslint . --no-inline-config`, a
whole-repo scan CI owns. Run here instead over the diff's lintable files at `ccec095`:
(1) the universe is read from `eslint.config.mjs` itself, whose file globs are
`**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}`; (2) `--format json` reports **11 files linted, 0 errors, 0
warnings**, exit 0 — the same 11 lintable paths the diff touches; (3) the invariance claim is the config's
own, stated in its header and measured there with a positive control: this repo *"runs one
`eslint.config.mjs`, which never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed
`@typescript-eslint` rules) for ANY file"*, so no edit in this diff can move a verdict on a file it does
not touch.

## Acceptance notes

Noted, not filed — each is prose about a measurement taken before this rename, not a defect:

- `.changeset/18122-closed-duration-types.md` names `FileValue.duration` among the six rows the #18122 unit
  set was derived from. That sentence was true when it was measured and rewriting another card's
  unreleased changeset would rewrite their record, so it is left verbatim. Carrier if it ever matters: the
  release that ships both changesets.
- `docs/adr/0104-field-runtime-value-shape-contract.md:459` prints the wave-1 inline shape as
  `{ url, name?, size?, mimeType?, alt?, duration? }`. ADR prose is a decision record, and the measured
  precedent is that renames do not sweep it — after `ApiEndpoint.cacheTtl` became `cacheTtlSeconds` in spec
  17, `docs/adr/0121-...md` still spells `cacheTtl` twice, and a control grep for five other already-renamed
  keys across `docs/adr/**` returns zero. Editing it would also make this PR Tier H governed for a prose
  line whose rename channel is the ADR-0087 ledger this PR adds. Carrier: none — deliberately.

## Refused, and why

- ⛔ Did not adopt `DurationSeconds`/`DurationMs`, add `.int()`, or narrow either value — ruling A forbids it, and the fractional-second case is pinned so a later sweep cannot quietly do it.
- ⛔ Did not edit `docs/adr/**` or `.changeset/18122-...md` (above).
- ⛔ Did not re-anchor `packages/spec/authorable-surface.base.json`; its `baseRev` note on a shallow checkout is informational and `check:authorable-surface` is green.
- ⛔ Did not mark this ready, enqueue, merge or arm auto-merge.
